text:
Alex W: Heads-up — prepping the PM for a latency postmortem. Can anyone point me to the canonical dashboards/panels for TTFT p50/p95/p99 and tokens/sec by model for last 24h?
Priya K: start with the latency master dashboard -> https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/latency-master, row 'TTFT by model' and the 'Tokens/s by model' panel. switch time to 24h and group by model.
Jo C: if you want raw PromQL snippets for panels: 
Jo C: ```
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(redwood_runtime_ttft_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, model))
```
Jo C: p50 -> 0.5, p99 -> 0.99.
Jo C: tokens/sec (1m): ```sum(rate(redwood_tokens_generated_total[1m])) by (model)```
Miguel: for route-level breakdown: `sum(rate(redwood_tokens_generated_total[1m])) by (model, route)` and add `job=\"inference\"` to filter hosted traffic.
Observability Bot: incident-summary: alert=ttft_p99_spike; affected_models=[gpt-large,gpt-legacy]; p99_change=+2.1x; window=15m
Alex W: saw that. Is that coming from the current global alert thresholds? Where are those defined?
Priya K: rules live in ops-alerts repo -> rules/ttft_p99.yaml. default trigger is p99 > 1.5s for 5m for hosted. We have a couple model-specific overrides in the same file.
Jo C: suggestion: temporarily raise gpt-large threshold to 2.0s until batching + KV-cache rollout finishes, or add a model-specific override to avoid noisy paging.
Miguel: also consider excluding scheduled loadtests from alerting. easiest pattern: add `job!\=\"loadtest\"` to the alert query or add a label `test_run=true` on loadtest jobs and filter them out.
Alex W: can someone open a quick PR to ops-alerts to (1) add a model override for gpt-large and (2) add a `job!\=\"loadtest\"` clause? tag me in the PR.
Priya K: I'll draft the PR, include thresholds and rationale.
Jo C: for the postmortem we also need a trace example and logs for a slow request sample. Jaeger quick search: https://jaeger.redwood.ai/search?service=inference&minDuration=1000
Jo C: Loki query for long TTFT logs: ```
{app=\"inference\"} |= \"TTFT\" | json | duration_ms > 1000 | sort_desc(duration_ms) | limit 20
```
Miguel: i'll open the PR now and ping @Alex W. i'll add the model-specific numbers and note this is temporary until canary batching is fully rolled.
Deploy Bot: deploy: batching-optimizer canary rolled at 04:12 UTC (sha: a1b2c3d)
Observability Bot: alert-update: ttft_p99_violation muted for job=\"loadtest\" (proposed)
Alex W: perfect. Can SRE please sanity-check the proposed thresholds in the PR? I want to include their sign-off in the PM.
Priya K: i'll review and add comments by 09:00 PT. :+1:
Alex W: thanks all — will assemble the PN with dashboard screenshots and the trace/log links after the PR lands.
